summary.definition: CPU·GPU·ASIC·NPU는 범용성·병렬성·전용 최적화가 다른 계산 자원이다.
summary.mechanism: workload의 연산 패턴·전력·지연·프로그래밍 요구가 어떤 가속기를 선택할지 결정한다.

researchEvidence.statement: NVIDIA's CUDA guide models heterogeneous systems with CPU host code and GPU device code, describes GPUs as highly parallel processors, and exposes matrix, tile, tensor-core, and multi-level memory operations as separate performance mechanisms.
researchEvidence.scope: CPU/GPU division of work, parallel matrix computation, precision, and memory hierarchy
researchEvidence.invalidation: CUDA is an NVIDIA programming and hardware model; it is not a universal description of every GPU, ASIC, NPU, workload, or measured performance result.

researchEvidence.statement: Google Cloud documents TPUs as application-specific integrated circuits designed for machine-learning workloads, with matrix-multiply units, vector/scalar units, reduced-precision arithmetic, and on-chip high-bandwidth memory.
researchEvidence.scope: Domain-specific AI accelerators and matrix-oriented hardware
researchEvidence.invalidation: A TPU architecture is one accelerator design; its features cannot be generalized to all ASICs, NPUs, models, or production cost/performance without workload-specific evidence.
